description: A new building geometry which represents a single building footprint. This geometry consists of adjoining building parts which have been determined to be part of the same building. When contained in a Land Use Site, adjoining building parts will be represented by a single feature.

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

versiondate.description: Date when the version was last updated.

versionavailablefromdate.description: The date this version of the feature became the latest version.

versionavailabletodate.description: The date this version of the feature was superseded by an update or ceased to exist.

changetype.description: The type of change that generated a new version of the feature.
enum: Moved From A Different Feature Type
Moved To A Different Feature Type

geometry_area_m2.description: The measured area of the geometry in square metres.

geometry_updatedate.description: Date when the attribute was last updated.

theme.description: The OS NGD Theme to which the feature belongs.

description.description: A single descriptive value intended for a quick understanding of what the feature represents.

description_updatedate.description: Date when the building description was last updated.

physicalstate.description: The state of the building in relation to its physical condition.

physicalstate_updatedate.description: Date when the physical state was last updated.

buildingpartcount.description: Count of building parts within the building.

isinsite.description: Flag to indicate whether the building is within a Land Use Site.

primarysiteid.description: Identifier of the primary site associated with the building. The primary site is the smallest site which contains the building feature.

containingsitecount.description: Count of sites that the building is contained within.

mainbuildingid.description: Populated if the feature is not the main building. Can be used to identify the main building within the same site.

mainbuildingid_ismainbuilding.description: Flag to indicate whether the building is the primary building within the site. This has been captured by OS surveyors as the most normal building a casual visitor would report to within the Land Use Site.

mainbuildingid_updatedate.description: Date when the main building was updated.

buildinguse.description: Describes what the Building is used for and can have up to two values. The value will be 'Mixed Use' where more than two uses are identified.

buildinguse_oslandusetiera.description: A high-level description of the main activity that takes place at the location or that the feature supports.

buildinguse_addresscount_total.description: Total count of built complete address UPRNs associated with the building.

buildinguse_addresscount_residential.description: Count of residential built complete address UPRNs associated with the building.

buildinguse_addresscount_commercial.description: Count of commercial built complete address UPRNs associated with the building.

buildinguse_addresscount_other.description: Count of other (not residential or commercial) built complete address UPRNs associated with the building.

buildinguse_updatedate.description: Date when the building use was updated.

connectivity.description: Describes how the building is connected to other buildings.

connectivity_updatedate.description: Date when the building connectivity was updated.

constructionmaterial.description: The primary material from which the building is constructed. Construction material is recorded for addressable buildings. It may be recorded for some non-addressable buildings, but the majority of these will have construction material recorded as NULL.

constructionmaterial_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

constructionmaterial_updatedate.description: Date when the construction material was last updated.

constructionmaterial_source.description: Indicates the data source of the construction material.

constructionmaterial_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the construction material was created, for example, via remote survey or via an automated process.

constructionmaterial_thirdpartyprovenanc.description: The provenance of the construction material provided by the third party data provider, for example, the name of an organisation and the specific dataset provided by that organisation.

buildingage_period.description: The period (i.e. a range of years) in which the building was constructed. Construction period is recorded for addressable buildings. It may be recorded for some non-addressable buildings, but the majority of these will have construction period recorded as NULL.

buildingage_year.description: The year in which the building was constructed, for buildings constructed post-1999 and where available.

buildingage_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

buildingage_updatedate.description: Date when the building age was last updated.

buildingage_source.description: Indicates the data source of the building age.

buildingage_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the building age was created, for example, via remote survey or via an automated process.

buildingage_thirdpartyprovenance.description: The provenance of the building age provided by the third party data provider, for example, the name of an organisation and the specific dataset provided by that organisation.

basementpresence.description: Indicates if a basement is present in the building. Basement presence is recorded for addressable buildings. It may be recorded for some non-addressable buildings, but the majority of these will have basement presence recorded as NULL.

basementpresence_selfcontained.description: Indicates if the basement contains a self-contained flat.

basementpresence_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

basementpresence_updatedate.description: Date when the basement presence was last updated.

basementpresence_source.description: Indicates the data source of the basement presence.

basementpresence_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the basement presence was created, for example, via remote survey or via an automated process.

basementpresence_thirdpartyprovenance.description: The provenance of the basement presence provided by the third party data provider, for example, the name of an organisation and the specific dataset provided by that organisation.

numberoffloors.description: The maximum number of occupiable floors at or above ground level within a building.

numberoffloors_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

numberoffloors_updatedate.description: Date when the number of floors was last updated.

numberoffloors_source.description: Indicates the data source of the number of floors. For buildings with a populated number of floors value, this can be either 'Ordnance Survey' or 'Energy Performance Certificate Authority'.

numberoffloors_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the number of floors was created, for example, via remote sensing survey or via an automated process.

height_absolutemin_m.description: The height, above datum, of the underlying ground surface.

height_absoluteroofbase_m.description: The height, above datum, of the base of the roof, that is, where the roof intersects the building walls.

height_absolutemax_m.description: The height, above datum, of the highest point of the building; this could include a chimney or other structure on a building.

height_relativeroofbase_m.description: The difference in height between the intersection of the external building walls and the underlying ground surface and the base of the roof of the building.

height_relativemax_m.description: The difference in height between the intersection of the external building walls and the underlying ground surface and the highest point on the building.

height_confidencelevel.description: The confidence in the quality of the height attributes for the building expressed in qualitative terms.

height_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date the imagery was captured that has been used to derive the height information.

height_updatedate.description: Date when the height was last updated.

roofmaterial_primarymaterial.description: The primary roof material present on the building.

roofmaterial_solarpanelpresence.description: Indicates if solar panels are present on the roof of the building.

roofmaterial_greenroofpresence.description: Indicates if the roof of the building is at least partially covered with vegetation. This is usually specifically installed on a growing medium with a waterproof membrane, for environmental reasons.

roofmaterial_confidenceindicator.description: An indication of whether the roof material output was expected, or if not, the reason why the quality may be lower.
enum: Existing Building Changed Since Imagery Capture
New Building Surveyed After Imagery Capture

roofmaterial_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date the imagery was captured that has been used to derive the roof material information.

roofmaterial_updatedate.description: Date when the roof material was last updated.

roofmaterial_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the roof material attributes were created, for example, via remote sensing survey or via an automated process.

roofshapeaspect_shape.description: An indication of the general shape characteristic of the roof of the building.

roofshapeaspect_areapitched_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas that have a pitch value of > 15°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areaflat_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas that have a pitch value of <= 15°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingnorth_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 337.5° and < 360° or >= 0 and < 22.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingnortheast_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 22.5° and < 67.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingeast_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 67.5° and < 112.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingsoutheast_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 112.5° and < 157.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingsouth_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 157.5° and < 202.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingsouthwest_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 202.5° and < 247.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingwest_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 247.5° and < 292.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areafacingnorthwest_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas with an aspect >= 292.5° and < 337.5°. Note that this measured area value is geometric (3D) rather than the planimetric (2D) measured area represented by geometry_area_m2.

roofshapeaspect_areaindeterminable_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas that have an indeterminable aspect. For example, areas obscured by vegetation or shadow, such as in an urban 'canyon'. Note that this measured area value is planimetric (2D) rather than geometric (3D), and is different to the other roofshapeaspect_area values.

roofshapeaspect_areatotal_m2.description: The sum of all roof face areas, excluding those with indeterminable aspects. Note that this measure area value is a combination of geometric (3D) and planimetric (2D) area values because it is comprised of all known and unknown areas. Where the roofshapeaspect_areaindeterminable_m2 value is equal to 0, this value will be entirely a geometric (3D) area value.

roofshapeaspect_confidenceindicator.description: An indication of whether the roof shape and aspect output was expected, or if not, the reason why the quality may be lower.
enum: Existing Building Changed Since Imagery Capture
New Building Surveyed After Imagery Capture

roofshapeaspect_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date the imagery was captured that has been used to derive the roof shape aspect information.

roofshapeaspect_updatedate.description: Date when the roof shape aspect was last updated.

roofshapeaspect_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the roof shape and aspect attributes were created, for example, via remote sensing survey or via an automated process.

siteid.description: The identifier of the site the Building is within.

buildingversiondate.description: The date this version of the feature entered the OS National Geographic Database.

buildingpartid.description: The identifier of the Building Part the Building is created from.

buildingversiondate.description: The date this version of the feature entered the OS National Geographic Database.

uprn.description: The identifier of the addressable feature that is located within the Building.

buildingversiondate.description: The date this version of the feature entered the OS National Geographic Database.
